answer: No, the agreement does not contain an exclusivity obligation. Instead, it contains non-solicitation (non-compete) obligations regarding employees. Specifically, Section IX.C states: 'AVDU agrees that for a twenty four months (24) following the execution of this Agreement, AVDU shall not, without UTEK's prior written consent, directly or indirectly solicit for employment any present employee of UTEK, or request induce or advise any employee of UTEK to leave the employ of UTEK. In turn, UTEK agrees that it will not directly or indirectly solicit any present employee of AVDU.'
